🚀 cockpit | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a simple, graphical web interface for managing and monitoring Linux servers, making server administration more accessible and efficient.
✨ Key Features: • Web-based server administration interface • Interactive and lightweight design • Direct interaction with the operating system • Task management (containers, storage, network, logs)
📖 Summary: Cockpit is a user-friendly, web-based graphical interface for managing Linux servers. It allows system administrators to perform various tasks like managing containers, storage, networks, and inspecting logs directly from a web browser, bridging the gap between graphical tools and the command line.
